name: OGN Decoder for 3D Shape Generation
definition: A decoder network that maps a latent vector to a hierarchical octree representation of a 3D shape, supporting multiple output resolutions (64^3, 128^3, 256^3, 512^3).
summary: The OGN Decoder is a deep convolutional architecture that generates high-resolution 3D shapes via memory-efficient octree representations, avoiding the cubic complexity of standard voxel grids.
